description: This file contains Kotlin source code defining data classes, serialization logic, and a registry object for managing UI display configurations of tools within an Android app. It includes functionality for loading configuration from JSON assets, resolving tool display summaries based on context and parameters, and utility methods for string processing and data extraction.

classes.name: ToolDisplayActionSpec
classes.description: Serializable data class representing action specifications for tools, including optional label and detail keys.

classes.name: ToolDisplaySpec
classes.description: Serializable data class encapsulating display properties of a tool like emoji, title, label, detail keys, and actions.

classes.name: ToolDisplayConfig
classes.description: Serializable data class representing the overall configuration for tool displays, including version, fallback spec, and tools map.

classes.name: ToolDisplaySummary
classes.description: Data class representing a summarized display information for a tool, including name, emoji, title, label, verb, and detail lines; with computed properties for formatted output.

classes.name: ToolDisplayRegistry
classes.description: Singleton object managing loading, caching, and resolving tool display summaries from configuration JSON; includes utility functions for string processing and data extraction.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves and returns a tool display summary based on context, name, arguments, and metadata, applying fallback and defaults.

methods.name: loadConfig
methods.description: Loads and caches the tool display configuration JSON from assets.

methods.name: titleFromName
methods.description: Generates a human-readable title from a tool name string.

methods.name: normalizeVerb
methods.description: Normalizes and cleans up verb strings, replacing underscores with spaces.

methods.name: readDetail
methods.description: Constructs a detail string for 'read' operations based on args.

methods.name: pathDetail
methods.description: Extracts path detail string from args.

methods.name: firstValue
methods.description: Retrieves the first non-blank value from args based on provided keys.

methods.name: valueForPath
methods.description: Navigates a JsonObject to retrieve a value based on a dot-separated path.

methods.name: renderValue
methods.description: Renders a JsonElement into a string, with handling for primitives and arrays.

methods.name: shortenHomeInString
methods.description: Replaces home directory paths with '~' in a string for cleaner display.

methods.name: asStringOrNull
methods.description: Extension function to safely get string content from a JsonPrimitive.

methods.name: asNumberOrNull
methods.description: Extension function to safely parse a number from a JsonPrimitive.
